name: semantic-governance
title: Semantic Governance (Ontology + Knowledge Graph)
description: Overlay blueprint that adds an enterprise governance layer: define a business vocabulary as an Ontology, build a knowledge Graph Model of entity relationships, query it with a Graph Queryset, and connect it to physical data via semantic models — optionally consumed by a Data Agent. Best added on top of existing data pipelines.
best_for: Enterprise-wide governance: a unified business vocabulary and knowledge graph on top of existing analytics, improving agent grounding and cross-domain consistency.
primary_storage: Existing Lakehouse or Warehouse (usually pre-existing from an upstream blueprint)
key_ingestion: None new — overlay reuses existing ingestion

item_set.purpose: Knowledge graph of entities and edges
Optional NL consumption grounded on the vocabulary

decisions.guidance: Start single-domain and expand; enterprise-wide needs cross-team term stewardship.
Data Agent for conversational grounding; Report for governed dashboards; both for full coverage.
fabio context tenant --format owl can export a tenant scan as OWL; fabio ontology import ingests OWL/RDF.

build_with.deploy_ordering: Ontology + GraphModel deploy before the Data Agent that grounds on them; fabio deploy orders DataAgent after its data sources (including GraphModel).
outline: Define the ontology (entity + relationship types) — see workflow ontology-tutorial, or import OWL.
Build a Graph Model of entities/edges and a Graph Queryset for traversal.
Bind the vocabulary to physical data via a semantic model.
Optionally publish a Data Agent grounded on the ontology (see workflow data-agent-setup).
